learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge regarding the technology of processing metallic and non-metallic materials, including conventional, modern, and unconventional technologies, and elements of plastic and composite material elaboration at the current technical level.
Explain and interpret types of technological processes, projects, etc., associated with the field of study.

syllabus_topics: General problems of the production process in machine and apparatus construction
Technological properties of metallic and non-metallic materials
Processes and procedures for primary and secondary elaboration of ferrous and non-ferrous metallic materials, plastics, and composite materials
Technological principles and procedures for manufacturing metallic products by casting (in temporary, permanent, pressure, vacuum, continuous molds, etc.)
Technological principles and procedures for manufacturing metallic products by plastic deformation (rolling, drawing, forging, die forging, extrusion, deep drawing, etc.)
Technological principles and procedures for sheet metal processing by cutting with associated edges
Fundamental phenomena, technological principles, and procedures for manufacturing products by powder aggregation
Study of casting properties of metallic materials
Influence of forming-casting factors on parts cast in temporary molds
Influence of technological factors on the quality of parts cast in permanent, vacuum, centrifugal molds
Study of the technological itinerary of a foundry. Calculation of the metallic charge of a cupola
Influence of technological factors during deformation on the work hardening of metallic materials
Determination of technological parameters for processing by drawing, deep drawing, die forging, stamping, and rolling

assessment_methods.method: Ongoing activity (including laboratory activity, interest in the discipline)

assessment_rules: The final grade consists of 66% from a written exam and 34% from ongoing activity. The written exam has 4 subjects, each contributing 25% to the exam grade. A minimum passing grade of 5 is required for each subject of the written exam and for all evaluation criteria. Participation in laboratory sessions is also mandatory.
